title: How to Cancel Nintendo Switch Online — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Nintendo Switch Online subscription. Turn off auto-renewal from your Switch console or Nintendo website. Keep playing offline games.
intro: Nintendo Switch Online cancellation simply turns off auto-renewal. Your membership stays active until the expiration date. You can do it from the Switch console or Nintendo's website.

steps.title: Go to Nintendo eShop or website
steps.text: On Switch: Open Nintendo eShop → click your profile icon → Nintendo Switch Online. On web: ec.nintendo.com/my/membership.

steps.title: Find auto-renewal settings
steps.text: Navigate to your membership settings. Look for "Turn Off Automatic Renewal" option.

steps.title: Turn off auto-renewal
steps.text: Click "Turn Off Automatic Renewal" and confirm. Your membership continues until the current period expires.
steps.tip: If you have a family plan, only the family group admin can manage the subscription.

steps.title: Confirm via email
steps.text: Nintendo sends a confirmation email. Your online features (multiplayer, cloud saves, classic game library) remain active until the expiration date.

warnings: Cloud save data may be deleted after a period without an active subscription — download important saves.
Online multiplayer stops working after your membership expires.
NES/SNES/N64/Game Boy games (included with membership) become inaccessible.
Family plan members all lose access if the admin cancels.
The Expansion Pack (N64, Sega Genesis games) is part of the higher tier — it's removed with cancellation.

faqs.q: Can I play online without Nintendo Switch Online?
faqs.a: Most games require NSO for online multiplayer. Free-to-play games (Fortnite, Apex, Rocket League) do NOT require NSO.

faqs.q: What happens to my cloud saves?
faqs.a: Cloud saves are preserved for a period (around 6 months) after membership expires. After that, they may be deleted. Download saves locally as backup.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Nintendo?
faqs.a: Nintendo's refund policy is strict. Contact Nintendo customer support for requests within a few days of purchase. They rarely offer refunds after the membership has been active.

faqs.q: Is the Expansion Pack worth keeping?
faqs.a: The base NSO ($3.99/mo or $19.99/year) gets you cloud saves and basic online. Expansion Pack ($49.99/year) adds N64, Sega, and GBA games. Cancel Expansion Pack and keep base to save money.

refund.details: Nintendo rarely offers refunds for Switch Online memberships. Contact Nintendo support to request — success varies by region and timing.

retentionTactics: Nintendo doesn't use aggressive retention tactics. The process is clean.
